Mapping of accounts excluded from fees.
Mapping of accounts excluded from max transaction/wallet limits.
Mapping marking AMM pairs whose transfers are treated as buys/sells.

Owner-only setter for sell and early sell fees, capped at 25%.

Owner-only setter for the dev wallet.
View helper returning fee exclusion status of an account.
Overridden ERC20 transfer hook implementing blacklist, limits, delay, early sell tax, fee taking and swap trigger.
Private function swapping contract tokens for ETH through the Uniswap router.
Private function adding ETH/token liquidity to the Uniswap router.
Private function that swaps accumulated fees and distributes ETH via low level calls.

Low level call transferring the entire contract ETH balance to marketingWallet.

edges.reason: from is used to index automatedMarketMakerPairs to detect a sell.
to is used to index automatedMarketMakerPairs to detect a buy.
amount is compared against maxTransactionAmount.
amount plus balanceOf(to) is compared against maxWallet.
fees are computed as amount.mul(totalFees).div(100).
fee split is accumulated into tokensForLiquidity.
fee split is accumulated into tokensForMarketing.
fee split is accumulated into tokensForDev.
_transfer reads and writes the blacklist mapping before moving tokens.
_transfer reads and sets the swapping guard around swapBack.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFees to decide whether fees apply.
_transfer reads _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount for limit checks.
_transfer compares block.number against launchedAt for anti-bot logic.
_transfer calls owner() to bypass limits for the owner.
_transfer uses tx.origin for the anti-sniper transfer delay.
tx.origin is used as the key written into _holderLastTransferTimestamp.
_transfer uses block.timestamp to decide the early sell tax branch.
block.timestamp is stored as the first buy timestamp of a holder.
_transfer triggers swapBack when the contract balance exceeds the threshold.
swapBack reads the contract token balance into contractBalance.
contractBalance is compared against swapTokensAtAmount.
tokensForLiquidity is read and reset inside swapBack.
tokensForMarketing is read and reset inside swapBack.
tokensForDev is read and reset inside swapBack.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens.
swapBack calls addLiquidity when liquidity tokens remain.
devWallet is used as the destination of the ETH value call.
marketingWallet is used as the destination of the remaining ETH call.
swapBack performs an external low level call sending ETH to devWallet.
swapBack performs an external low level call sending all ETH to marketingWallet.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swap function.
swapTokensForEth uses uniswapV2Router as the swap target.
block.timestamp is passed as the router deadline.
addLiquidity invokes the router addLiquidityETH function.
addLiquidity uses uniswapV2Router as the liquidity target.
block.timestamp is passed as the router deadline.
onlyOwner reverts unless _owner equals the caller.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
enableTrading is restricted to the owner.
removeLimits is restricted to the owner.
disableTransferDelay is restricted to the owner.
setEarlySellTax is restricted to the owner.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount is restricted to the owner.
updateMaxTxnAmount is restricted to the owner.
updateMaxWalletAmount is restricted to the owner.
excludeFromMaxTransaction is restricted to the owner.
updateSwapEnabled is restricted to the owner.

updateSellFees is restricted to the owner.
excludeFromFees is restricted to the owner.

setAutomatedMarketMakerPair is restricted to the owner.
updateMarketingWallet is restricted to the owner.
updateDevWallet is restricted to the owner.
Chire is restricted to the owner.
enableTrading sets tradingActive to true.
enableTrading sets swapEnabled to true.
enableTrading writes the launch block number.
removeLimits disables limitsInEffect.
disableTransferDelay disables transferDelayEnabled.
setEarlySellTax writes enableEarlySellTax.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount writes swapTokensAtAmount.
newAmount parameter is validated and assigned to swapTokensAtAmount.
updateMaxTxnAmount writes maxTransactionAmount.
updateMaxWalletAmount writes maxWallet.
excludeFromMaxTransaction writes the exclusion mapping.
updateSwapEnabled writes swapEnabled.
updateBuyFees recomputes the total buy fees.
updateSellFees recomputes sellTotalFees from owner supplied values.
updateSellFees writes sellLiquidityFee.
updateSellFees writes sellMarketingFee.
updateSellFees writes sellDevFee.
excludeFromFees writes the fee exclusion mapping.
blacklistAccount writes the blacklist mapping.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair reads uniswapV2Pair for the guard check.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to the private setter.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes the AMM pair mapping.
updateMarketingWallet writes marketingWallet.
updateDevWallet writes devWallet.
Constructor sets the immutable router address.
Constructor creates and stores the immutable Uniswap pair.
Constructor initializes marketingWallet to the owner.
Constructor initializes devWallet to the owner.
Constructor computes and sets maxTransactionAmount from the supply.
Constructor computes and sets swapTokensAtAmount from the supply.
Constructor computes and sets maxWallet from the supply.
Constructor marks the created pair as an AMM pair.
Constructor calls excludeFromMaxTransaction for router, pair and owner.
Constructor calls excludeFromFees for owner, contract and dead address.
Constructor calls the private AMM pair setter.
Constructor mints the entire total supply to msg.sender.
Chire uses msg.sender as the source of transferFrom calls.
Chire loops over transferFrom after self-approving the total supply.
Chire iterates over the recipients array parameter.
Chire uses the values array to size each transfer.
Each batch transferFrom moves tokens from msg.sender without further checks.
Chire approves owner() to itself using the full total supply.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists inside _transfer and should be merged into the transfer function node.
The to parameter only exists inside _transfer and should be merged into the transfer function node.
The amount parameter only exists inside _transfer and should be merged into the transfer function node.
The fees local variable is transient fee math inside _transfer.
The isBuy local boolean is a transient branch flag inside _transfer.
The recipients parameter belongs solely to Chire.
The values parameter belongs solely to Chire.
The newAmount parameter is only used by updateSwapTokensAtAmount.
The contractBalance local is only used for swapBack bookkeeping.
The totalTokensToSwap local is only used for swapBack bookkeeping.
The ethForLiquidity local is only used for swapBack distribution math.
